paragraphs: The CNPS-ML11 type drilling fluid volume sensor is composed of an ultrasonic transmitter, a receiving device and a transmitter. The ultrasonic wave emitted by the ultrasonic transmitting device is reflected by the surface of the object, and then is received by the receiving device. The transmitter converts the signal generated during ultrasonic emission and reception to the standard current signal. The probe of the sensor sends out a series of ultrasonic pulses, while the ultrasonic pulse returns after receiving the liquid level, and is received by the sensor. The filtering device in the sensor can distinguish true echoes from the liquid surface from various false echoes from sound waves, wave noise and rotating agitator blade noise. The pulse wave is converted from the time of temperature compensation to the time used by the emission to the liquid surface and then back to the sensor.

summary: Shale density meter for mud logging unit The shale density meter is an instrument to measure the density of shale.

sections.heading: Overview
paragraphs: Measuring mudstone density is to monitor abnormal pressure formation. According to the regulation of mudstone compaction, the porosity of mudstone decrease in exponential function way when the depth are increasing in normal condition, mudstone density increases with the increase of depth. title: CL-LL11 Paddle Flow Out Sensor
summary: A stainless-steel paddle sensor that converts drilling-fluid outlet flow changes into a 4-20 mA signal for relative flow monitoring and mud logging analysis.

sections.heading: Overview
paragraphs: The CL-LL11 measures relative changes in drilling-fluid outlet flow. Flowing mud deflects a paddle, and the resulting angular movement is converted into an electrical signal for the mud logging acquisition system.

The sensor separates its mechanical transmission components from the electrical section. Stainless-steel structural parts and sealed electrical components are intended to improve corrosion resistance, durability and wellsite serviceability.

sections.heading: Specifications
paragraphs: Measurement range: 0-100% relative change; no absolute flow calibration.

sections.heading: Measurement principle
paragraphs: Outlet flow pushes the paddle and rotates the bent arm and shaft. A geared mechanism transfers this movement to a conductive-plastic potentiometer. The change in resistance represents the relative change in mud flow and is converted to a 4-20 mA signal.
The paddle can be installed in four configurations by reversing its orientation and selecting the appropriate arm position, allowing adaptation to different outlet geometries and flow conditions.

sections.heading: Installation and maintenance
paragraphs: Mount the fixing frame securely at the mud-pit outlet. Confirm that the paddle moves freely and cannot strike the channel or accumulated solids. Remove adhered drilling fluid promptly to maintain reliable movement.

Route and protect the cable so that it does not obstruct wellsite work or suffer impact damage. Reliably connect the external grounding terminal. A compatible safety barrier is required when the sensor is installed in a hazardous location.
The zero and full-scale controls are located inside the explosion-protected junction box. Adjustment should be performed only by qualified personnel under safe conditions.

title: YC-03D Electric Mud Degasser
summary: A compact electric degasser for continuous extraction, drying and cleaning of gas from drilling mud before gas-analysis equipment in a mud logging system.

sections.heading: Overview
paragraphs: The YC-03D electric degasser is designed for continuous extraction of gas from drilling mud in oilfield mud logging applications. It combines a gas-collection chamber, explosion-protected motor, agitator and height-adjustment mechanism in a compact assembly.
The unit supports the gas treatment sequence of degassing, drying and cleaning before the sample gas is delivered to downstream analysis equipment.

sections.heading: Specifications
paragraphs: Gas-collection chamber height adjustment: at least 300 mm.
Explosion-protection marking: Ex d IIB T4 Gb.
Total equipment weight: less than 30 kg.
Gas treatment process: degassing, drying and cleaning.

sections.heading: Product features
paragraphs: The height of the gas-collection chamber can be adjusted with the handwheel without tools when mud flow conditions change. The mounting arrangement supports square or round mud tanks.

A mud shield in the collection chamber helps prevent drilling fluid from entering the gas line. The main structure and components are made from stainless steel for corrosion resistance and easier maintenance.

sections.heading: Installation and operation
paragraphs: The unit may be shipped in separate components for transport. After assembly, verify that the agitator rotates in the correct direction. If rotation is reversed, qualified electrical personnel can correct the phase sequence by interchanging two phase conductors.
Tighten the explosion-protected junction-box cover and cable entry after wiring, and connect protective earth correctly. Check the gas line for leakage before operation.

Do not operate the unit with phase imbalance, phase loss or incorrect supply frequency. Set the immersion depth so that drilling fluid cannot splash over the internal mud shield, and regularly remove accumulated sand from the collection chamber.

title: RADA-32 DDLJA5 80 GHz Radar Level Transmitter
summary: A high-accuracy 80 GHz radar transmitter for non-contact liquid and bulk-solids level measurement, with a range up to 60 m and two-wire 4-20 mA/HART output.

sections.heading: Overview
paragraphs: The RADA-32 DDLJA5 is an 80 GHz non-contact radar level transmitter for continuous liquid and bulk-solids level measurement. In mud logging applications, it can be installed above a pit or tank to measure level without immersing a probe in the drilling fluid.

Intelligent echo processing supports false-echo learning, separation of multiple echoes and dynamic target tracking. These functions are designed to maintain stable measurement in the presence of agitators, vapor, dust and electromagnetic interference.

sections.heading: Configured specifications
paragraphs: Enclosure: aluminum alloy, IP66/IP68 at 0.2 bar.
Gas explosion-protection marking for the described configuration: Ex db IIC T6 Gb.

sections.heading: Available platform options
paragraphs: The product family supports PFA, 316L with PTFE, or 316L with PFA antenna materials, and aluminum-alloy or stainless-steel enclosures. Threaded, flanged, bracket and suspended mounting arrangements are available for different applications.
Available signal configurations include two-wire 4-20 mA/HART, four-wire RS485/Modbus, and combined 4-20 mA plus RS485/Modbus. Bluetooth 5.4 support is available on compatible configurations.

The broader platform supports process pressures from -0.1 to 3.0 MPa and process-temperature versions up to 220 °C. These ratings are configuration-dependent and must be confirmed for the selected model before ordering.

sections.heading: Applications and installation
paragraphs: The transmitter is suitable for liquid level and higher-dielectric-constant powder or granular solid level measurement. Typical industries include oil and gas, chemical processing and mining, including applications where hazardous-area approval is required.

Mount the transmitter above the measured surface with an unobstructed path for the radar beam. Select the antenna material, process connection, enclosure, output and approval to match the process medium, temperature, pressure and hazardous-area classification.

The product family lists gas and dust protection options including Ex db IIC T6 Gb, Ex ia IIC T6 Ga, Ex tb IIIC T80 °C Db and Ex ia IIIC T200 80 °C Da. Approval availability depends on the ordered configuration and must be verified against the supplied certificate and nameplate.
